objective.statement: Add a paragraph of text to AboutView.tsx that describes the clock widget shown on HomeView.tsx.

complexity.rationale: One static paragraph in an existing presentational view; no new state, dependency, contract or component.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: AboutView renders a paragraph of text in addition to the existing About heading.
The paragraph describes the clock widget on the Home view: it shows the current time, updates every second, and has a toggle between the 24 hour and 12 hour view (default 24 hour).
The existing About heading and its test continue to pass unchanged.

in.statement:
src/views/about/AboutView.tsx: add one

below the heading, styled with the existing text-sm text-muted-foreground idiom, with a data-id from AboutView.testIds.ts.
src/views/about/AboutView.testIds.ts and AboutView.component.test.tsx: new test id and a test for the paragraph.

out.statement: Any change to HomeView.tsx or the Clock component, new dependencies, routing, a new About component, and copy for any widget other than the clock.

observations.statement: The card does not give the wording. The paragraph is static copy describing the clock as it exists today (live time updated every second, 24 hour default, a 12 hour view toggle button). The component test asserts the paragraph exists and mentions the clock, not the full sentence, so copy edits do not break it.

AboutView is currently a section with a single h1 and a data-id heading test id. The Clock widget (src/components/clock/Clock.tsx) renders a ticking time and a 12 hour view toggle button, and is mounted in HomeView.
